reviews.title: Great app well designed
reviews.text: Love the app and it’s already become useful for work I’ve been doing. I’ve also used it to showcase differences with style while using AI photos of outfits or style changes I was evaluating for myself. To instantly compare in real time made it easier to review! Love the app
reviews.author: TV user 2016
